name: Tape Bot
tagline: Rebuild the shows you follow into a private ad-free feed with your own chapters
description: It follows the podcasts and YouTube shows you subscribe to and republishes a tidied copy just for you: ad segments sliced out, your own chapter markers added, original notes and artwork kept intact. Everything lands on a private RSS address any player can take.
author: dvdaltizer
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
